reference_scope: 1 us fast-model sensitivity reference, not physical truth or R3

step_selection.choice: Fastest measured complete candidate meeting geometry and statistical criteria; all candidates and failures retained
step_selection.adjacency_scope: Record every accepted substep edge change and observed components; fixed-ID graph differences are diagnostic, not a per-bubble truth criterion

contact_correction_scope: Report cumulative magnitude and fraction of unconstrained motion. Contact reaction may dominate in a packed static cluster; verify each correction is expansive and Secondary OFF cannot cluster. Do not equate a large reaction fraction with attraction.
